title: The L¹ norm is bounded by testing against smooth compactly supported functions with |g| ≤ 1
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, w : ℝ^n → ℝ Lebesgue integrable and C ∈ ℝ. If ∫ w(x)·g(x) dx ≤ C for every C^∞ compactly supported g : ℝ^n → ℝ with |g(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, then ∫ |w(x)| dx ≤ C.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Eucl n → ℝ) (C : ℝ), Integrable w → (∀ g : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → ∫ x, w x * g x ≤ C) → ∫ x, |w x| ≤ C
